label: 通常プレイ：連鎖噴射
purpose: Generated screen mockup for specification planning; not implemented gameplay
prompt:
Design a finished 16:9 landscape PC videogame SCREEN MOCKUP for the original Japanese absurd physical comedy videogame 「全力退勤」 (Full-Speed Clock-Out). Use the attached earlier concept image as the reference for the SAME main character's identity, clothing, teal swivel office chair, red fire extinguisher, sunset-office world and logo language. This is a NEW gameplay-vision screen, not a reproduction of the promo poster. The requested visual direction is now much MORE CARTOONY, ridiculous, intense, triumphant and juicy: rounded stylized 3D toy forms, big clean color blocks, soft plastic/clay textures, bold dark comic outlines, extreme rubbery facial reactions, elastic red necktie, absurdly tall paper towers, comically oversized stationery, energetic orange/yellow/magenta graphic flourishes. The visual appeal is recognizable absurd Japanese indie arcade slapstick. Keep a cohesive reproducible chunky 3D game look. Sharp readable playing field, minimal realistic texture, minimal depth of field. Warm amber sunset, mint and teal desks, cream floors, red extinguisher and tie, green lit elevator goal.

The protagonist is an ADULT Japanese salaried employee with a very large round head, messy short black hair, very expressive wide eyes and cheeks, white rolled-sleeve shirt, navy trousers, loose red tie and lanyard. Seat him on a teal office chair with a black five-caster base, holding a large RED FIRE EXTINGUISHER and aiming its black nozzle BACKWARDS. Powerful white powder plume extends rearwards; he travels in the opposite direction. Floating paper has no weapon or dangerous explosion association. All action is friendly absurd physical toy comedy.

In play views, use a clearly ELEVATED THREE-QUARTER camera about 45 degrees above the cream floor, enough to see the layout, chair orientation and clear route. Make the player occupy roughly 15–20% of image height, a recognizable large gameplay avatar in lower center. Show front look-ahead space. Open mint-desk office on both sides of an obvious diagonal route, scattered prop clusters, vivid green EXIT sign and OPEN warmly glowing elevator in upper-right. Two deadpan adult coworkers continue paperwork at desks on the edges while the player is ridiculously frantic. Static furniture silhouettes are clear, moving paper particles are around the scene rather than covering the hero or goal. Dramatic effects appear at screen edges or around the current collision. Render the HUD and Japanese lettering as crisp game UI with cream/dark-ink backing, big legible characters, vermilion or yellow accents, little comic slants. It must look like an in-game screen mockup that explains what players see, rather than a concept art collage or promotional poster.
SCREEN 1: ORDINARY HIGH-ENERGY GAMEPLAY. The employee is boosting FAST along the diagonal aisle toward the elevator, chair leaning but still clearly touching the floor; exaggerated determination, inflated cheeks, streaming tie, tiny stars in his eyes. A newly knocked-over tower of office folders behind him scatters in an arc. Long white extinguisher plume behind him, yellow speed streaks confined to screen edges, gold flourish showing a third successful paper-break combo. Leave visible navigable floor ahead. One absurdly giant stapler sits on a side desk, a paper stack as tall as its coworker, background cat mug. It is joyous hectic gameplay.

EXACT readable HUD placement:
TOP LEFT compact dark-ink rounded panel: 「退勤タイム」 and large white 「00:12.84」.
TOP RIGHT cream outlined panel: 「被害総額」 and red 「¥1,280,000」; beneath it bold warm yellow 「3連鎖 ×3」.
BOTTOM LEFT compact cream gauge panel with red fire extinguisher icon: 「残圧 72%」 and segmented orange fill.
BOTTOM RIGHT tiny unobtrusive instruction strip: 「← → 旋回　SPACE 噴射」.
Near the green EXIT elevator, small world-space 「出口まで 18m」.
At upper middle, a short yellow/vermillion comic badge 「定時ラッシュ！」, taking only a little space and keeping the lane readable. There is NO giant game title obscuring the playfield. Composition especially shows hero, rearwards jet, route and goal together.
